rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for polite behavior or the quality of being polite.

example.english: They treat people with a lot of courtesy.
example.jyutping: keoi5 doi6 jan4 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6

rows.note: Use this for a courteous favor or gesture offered out of goodwill rather than obligation.

example.english: Thanks for the courtesy of buying a cake specially for me.
example.traditional: 多謝你嘅好意，仲特登買咗蛋糕畀我。
example.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 ge3 hou2 ji3 zung6 dak6 dang1 maai5 zo2 daan6 gou1 bei2 ngo5

rows.note: Use this specifically for a conventional polite remark or formula rather than a practical favor.

example.english: I knew those were just courtesy remarks, so I did not take them seriously.
example.traditional: 我知嗰啲只係客套說話，所以一句都冇當真。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zi1 go2 di1 zi2 hai6 haak3 tou3 syut3 waa6 so2 ji5 jat1 geoi3 dou1 mou5 dong3 zan1
